title: 第六章初遇鬼手门喽啰一第七章初遇鬼手门喽啰二
content_zh:
暮春时节，残阳如血，将西陲古道染上一层诡异的绯红。萧琰背着半旧的青布书箱，步履略显疲惫地走在回萧府的路上。他刚从百里之外的云台山书院归来，为求一本孤本古籍，足足在山中耽搁了半月有余。书箱里除了那本珍贵的《南华经注疏》，便只有几件换洗衣物和些许干粮，沉甸甸的不是行囊，而是满脑子的经义与对家中老母的牵挂。
这条路他走了不下百次，自小便随父亲往返于书院与萧府之间。记忆里，这条路总是绿树成荫，鸟语花香，可今日不知为何，空气中却弥漫着一股若有若无的血腥气。道旁的古树歪歪扭扭，枝桠如鬼爪般伸向天空，偶尔传来几声鸦鸣，更添了几分阴森。萧琰皱了皱眉，握紧了手中的折扇——这扇子看似普通，扇骨却是由精铁打造，乃是父亲生前留下的防身之物，他虽为书生，却也跟着父亲学过几年粗浅的拳脚功夫，寻常蟊贼倒也能应付一二。
走至一处岔路口，路边的茅草突然无风自动，萧琰心中一紧，停下了脚步。他自幼便心思缜密，此刻更是不敢大意，缓缓转过身，警惕地打量着四周。“出来吧，躲在暗处算什么英雄好汉？”他的声音虽带着几分书生的温文，却也透着一股不容置疑的坚定。
话音刚落，三道黑影便从茅草从中窜了出来，呈三角之势将萧琰围在中间。为首的是一个满脸横肉的壮汉，左脸上一道长长的刀疤从眼角延伸到嘴角，显得狰狞可怖。他手中握着一把鬼头刀，刀身泛着寒光，显然是常年饮血的凶器。另外两个喽啰也手持短刃，眼神凶狠地盯着萧琰，仿佛饿狼盯着猎物。
“小子，识相的就把身上的钱财和书箱里的宝贝交出来，爷爷们还能留你一条全尸！”刀疤脸恶狠狠地说道，语气中满是威胁。
萧琰心中一沉，他看这三人的打扮，腰间都系着黑色腰带，腰带上绣着一只惨白的鬼手图案——这正是江湖中臭名昭著的“鬼手门”标志！“鬼手门”行事狠辣，专做打家劫舍、伤天害理之事，尤其喜欢劫掠文人墨客，只因文人多携带珍贵书籍或字画，且反抗能力较弱。没想到今日竟让自己遇上了。
“我乃萧府子弟萧琰，尔等竟敢在光天化日之下拦路抢劫，就不怕官府追查吗？”萧琰强压下心中的恐惧，试图用家族和官府来震慑对方。他知道萧府在当地也算有些声望，父亲生前曾在朝中为官，虽已去世多年，但府中仍与一些官员有往来，寻常盗匪一般不会轻易招惹萧府之人。
可刀疤脸听到“萧府”二字，却哈哈大笑起来，笑声粗犷而刺耳：“萧府？不过是个没落的官宦之家罢了，如今这西陲之地，谁不知道我‘鬼手门’的威名？官府那帮酒囊饭袋，早就被我们喂饱了，还敢来管爷爷们的事？”说着，他挥了挥手中的鬼头刀，“小子，别跟爷爷们废话，赶紧把东西交出来，不然别怪爷爷的刀不认人！”
萧琰知道谈判已无可能，只能硬着头皮应对。他缓缓打开折扇，扇面上题着“宁静致远”四字，此刻却成了他唯一的防身武器。他深吸一口气，回想起父亲教给他的拳脚招式，双脚分开与肩同宽，摆出了一个防御的姿势。
刀疤脸见萧琰竟敢反抗，眼中闪过一丝厉色，大喝一声：“不知死活的东西！给我上！”话音未落，旁边两个喽啰便挥舞着短刃扑了上来。左边的喽啰速度较快，短刃直刺萧琰的胸口，右边的喽啰则攻向他的下盘，想要限制他的行动。
萧琰不敢怠慢，身体猛地向左侧一躲，避开了左边喽啰的攻击，同时用手中的折扇狠狠向右边喽啰的手腕打去。只听“啪”的一声脆响，右边喽啰吃痛，短刃险些脱手，他惨叫一声，向后退了几步。左边的喽啰见一击未中，再次挥刀袭来，萧琰利用折扇的灵活性，不断格挡，扇骨与短刃碰撞，发出“叮叮当当”的声响。
可萧琰毕竟只是个书生，拳脚功夫只算粗浅，对付一个喽啰还能勉强支撑，对付两个喽啰便渐渐有些力不从心。几个回合下来，他的额头已渗出冷汗，呼吸也变得急促起来。刀疤脸在一旁冷眼旁观，见萧琰快要支撑不住，嘴角勾起一抹残忍的笑容，突然加入了战局。
鬼头刀威力巨大，刀风凌厉，萧琰根本不敢正面硬接。他只能不断躲闪，可身上还是被刀风扫到了几次，衣衫被划破，手臂上也留下了一道浅浅的伤口，鲜血瞬间渗了出来。疼痛感让萧琰的大脑更加清醒，他知道这样下去迟早会丧命，必须想办法突围。
他目光快速扫过四周，发现不远处有一片茂密的树林，若是能冲进树林，利用树木的遮挡，或许能有一线生机。于是，他故意卖了一个破绽，装作体力不支的样子，向后退了几步。刀疤脸以为萧琰已是强弩之末，大喜过望，挥刀便向他的脖颈砍去，想要一招制敌。
就在这千钧一发之际，萧琰突然脚下发力，身体猛地向后一跃，同时将手中的折扇掷向刀疤脸的眼睛。刀疤脸没想到萧琰会有此一招，慌忙躲闪，虽避开了折扇，却也错过了最佳的攻击时机。萧琰趁机转身，拔腿就向树林跑去。
“想跑？没那么容易！”刀疤脸怒吼一声，带着两个喽啰紧紧追了上来。萧琰拼命奔跑，耳边风声呼啸，身后的脚步声和喊杀声越来越近。他知道自己不能停下，一旦被追上，后果不堪设想。
跑进树林后，树木交错，道路崎岖，萧琰凭借着灵活的身形，在树木之间穿梭。刀疤脸等人虽然身手矫健，但在树林中却有些施展不开，速度慢了下来。萧琰趁机拉开了一些距离，可他毕竟体力有限，跑了一会儿后，便感觉双腿发软，呼吸也越来越困难。
就在他快要坚持不住的时候，前方突然传来一阵马蹄声。萧琰心中一喜，仿佛看到了救星，他用尽最后一丝力气，朝着马蹄声传来的方向大喊：“救命！救命啊！”
马蹄声越来越近，很快，一队官兵便出现在了萧琰的视线中。为首的是一位身着铠甲的将军，他看到萧琰狼狈的模样，以及身后追赶的“鬼手门”喽啰，脸色一沉，大喝一声：“大胆贼人，竟敢光天化日之下劫掠，给我拿下！”
官兵们训练有素，听到将军的命令后，立刻拔出腰间的佩刀，冲向刀疤脸等人。刀疤脸见来了官兵，心中大惊，知道自己不是对手，哪里还敢恋战，慌忙带着两个喽啰想要逃跑。可官兵们早已将他们团团围住，一番激战之后，刀疤脸和两个喽啰便被官兵制服，押了起来。

萧琰这才松了一口气，瘫坐在地上，大口大口地喘着粗气。那位将军翻身下马，走到萧琰身边，问道：“这位公子，你没事吧？”
萧琰勉强站起身，对着将军拱了拱手，说道：“多谢将军救命之恩，我没事，只是有些体力不支。”他顿了顿，又道：“在下萧府萧琰，今日多谢将军及时赶到，不然我恐怕早已命丧贼人之手。”
将军听到“萧琰”二字，眼中闪过一丝惊讶，随即笑道：“原来是萧公子，久仰大名。我乃本地守将李威，奉知府大人之命，在此巡查，没想到竟遇上了此事。萧公子不必客气，捉拿盗匪本就是我等职责所在。”
随后，李威让手下的官兵将刀疤脸等人押回官府审问，又派了两个士兵护送萧琰回萧府。萧琰再次向李威道谢后，便在士兵的护送下，继续踏上了回萧府的路。
此时，夕阳已经落下，夜幕开始降临，道路两旁亮起了零星的灯火。萧琰看着身边护送的士兵，心中感慨万千。他没想到，一次寻常的归途，竟会遭遇如此惊险之事，若不是李威将军及时赶到，后果不堪设想。同时，他也意识到，江湖险恶，仅凭自己这点粗浅的功夫，根本无法应对各种危机。或许，他该好好提升自己的实力了，不仅是为了保护自己，更是为了保护身边的人。
想着想着，萧府的大门已经出现在了眼前。门口的家丁看到萧琰回来，连忙迎了上去，搀扶着他进了府中。萧琰知道，这次的遭遇，只是他人生中的一个小插曲，未来或许还会遇到更多的挑战，但他已经做好了准备，迎接接下来的一切。
萧琰在两名士兵的护送下，终于踏入了萧府的大门。府内的灯笼早已点亮，暖黄的光芒驱散了夜的微凉，却未能完全抚平他心中的惊悸。家丁见他归来，连忙上前接过他手中早已松开的书箱，脸上满是关切：“公子，您可算回来了，老夫人这几日天天在门口盼着您呢。”
萧琰点点头，脚步略显虚浮地朝着内院走去。刚走到正厅门口，便看到老夫人拄着拐杖，在丫鬟的搀扶下迎了出来。老夫人头发已有些花白，脸上布满了岁月的痕迹，看到萧琰，眼中瞬间泛起了泪光：“琰儿，你可算回来了，在外受苦了吧？”
萧琰快步上前，握住老夫人的手，声音带着一丝沙哑：“娘，让您担心了，我没事，就是路上遇到了一点小波折。”他不想让老夫人太过担忧，便暂时轻描淡写地带过了遇劫之事。
可老夫人何等精明，一眼便看到了萧琰手臂上包扎的伤口，以及他衣衫上的破损痕迹，脸色顿时沉了下来：“琰儿，你老实告诉娘，是不是在路上遇到危险了？这伤口是怎么回事？”
见瞒不住老夫人，萧琰只好将路上遇到“鬼手门”喽啰抢劫，幸得李威将军所率官兵相救的事情一五一十地说了出来。老夫人听得心惊胆战，紧紧抓住萧琰的手，泪水顺着脸颊滑落：“我的儿啊，真是吓死娘了，还好你没事，要是你有个三长两短，娘可怎么活啊。”
萧琰连忙安慰道：“娘，您别担心，我这不是好好的回来了嘛。多亏了李威将军及时赶到，不然我恐怕真的就回不来了。而且那几个‘鬼手门’的喽啰已经被官兵抓住了，官府应该会严加审讯，不会再让他们出来害人了。”
老夫人这才稍稍放下心来，拉着萧琰走进正厅，让丫鬟赶紧去准备热水和饭菜。萧琰坐在椅子上，看着眼前熟悉的景象，心中的不安渐渐消散了一些。他拿起桌上的茶杯，喝了一口热茶，暖意顺着喉咙蔓延到全身，疲惫感也涌上心头。
没过多久，饭菜便端了上来。老夫人一直不停地给萧琰夹菜，叮嘱他多吃点，补充体力。萧琰一边吃着饭，一边和老夫人聊着在云台山书院的经历，说着自己如何找到那本《南华经注疏》，试图让老夫人彻底放下心来。
饭后，老夫人担心萧琰身体劳累，让他赶紧回房休息。萧琰回到自己的房间，房间里的陈设依旧，书桌上还放着他离开前正在研读的书籍。他走到书桌前，打开书箱，看着里面那本珍贵的《南华经注疏》，心中百感交集。若不是为了这本书，他也不会在山中耽搁半月，更不会在归途中遭遇这场劫难。
他脱下身上破损的衣衫，看着手臂上的伤口，回想起白天与“鬼手门”喽啰打斗的场景，心中仍有余悸。他知道，这次能够侥幸逃脱，全凭运气和李威将军的及时相救，若是下次再遇到这样的危险，他未必还有这样的好运气。
“看来，我不能再只专注于书本知识了，提升自身的武艺，才能在这险恶的江湖中保护自己和家人。”萧琰在心中暗暗下定决心。他想起父亲生前曾留下一些武功秘籍，被收藏在书房的暗格里，或许他可以从这些秘籍入手，开始学习真正的武艺。
第二天一早，萧琰便来到了书房。书房里弥漫着淡淡的墨香，书架上摆满了各种书籍，既有经史子集，也有一些兵法和武功秘籍。他走到书架旁，按照父亲生前告诉他的方法，转动了书架上的一本《孙子兵法》，书架缓缓向一侧移动，露出了一个暗格。
暗格里放着一个木盒，萧琰打开木盒，里面果然放着几本泛黄的武功秘籍，分别是《流云剑法》《清风掌法》和《基础内功心法》。他拿起一本《基础内功心法》，仔细翻阅起来。心法内容晦涩难懂，里面的许多术语他都从未见过，但他并没有放弃，而是耐心地逐字逐句研读，遇到不懂的地方，便标记出来，打算日后向懂武功的人请教。
就在萧琰沉浸在武功秘籍的世界中时，管家突然走了进来，恭敬地说道：“公子，外面有位李威将军派来的士兵，说有要事找您。”

萧琰心中一动，放下手中的秘籍，说道：“快请他进来。”
不一会儿，一位身着铠甲的士兵便走进了书房，对着萧琰拱了拱手：“萧公子，我是李威将军手下的士兵，奉将军之命前来告知您，昨日抓获的那几个‘鬼手门’喽啰已经开始审讯了，他们招供出‘鬼手门’近期在西陲一带活动频繁，似乎在寻找一件珍贵的宝物，而且他们还计划对萧府下手，因为他们听说萧府中藏有一件祖传的宝物。”

content_en:
In late spring, the setting sun is like blood, dyeing the ancient road in the west frontier with a strange crimson color. Xiao Yan carried a half-old blue cloth bookcase on his back and walked a little tiredly on the way back to Xiao Mansion. He had just returned from Yuntai Mountain Academy, a hundred miles away, and had been delayed in the mountains for more than half a month in order to obtain a unique ancient book. In addition to the precious "Commentary on the Nam Hwa Sutra", there were only a few changes of clothes and some dry food in the book box. What was heavy was not the luggage, but the mind full of the meaning of the sutra and concern for my mother at home.
He has walked this road no less than a hundred times, traveling back and forth between the academy and Xiao Mansion with his father since he was a child. In my memory, this road was always lined with green trees and full of birdsong and fragrant flowers. But today, for some unknown reason, there was a vague smell of blood in the air. The ancient trees beside the road were crooked and their branches stretched towards the sky like ghost claws. Occasionally, a few crows could be heard, adding to the gloominess. Xiao Yan frowned and clenched the folding fan in his hand - this fan looked ordinary, but its ribs were made of fine iron. It was a self-defense thing left by his father during his lifetime. Although he was a scholar, he had also learned some basic boxing and kicking skills from his father for a few years, so he could handle ordinary thieves.
Walking to a fork in the road, the thatch on the roadside suddenly became windless. Xiao Yan's heart tightened and he stopped. He has been thoughtful since he was a child, and he didn't dare to be careless at this moment. He turned around slowly and looked around cautiously. "Come out, what kind of hero is he hiding in the dark?" Although his voice was a bit gentle like a scholar, it also revealed an unquestionable determination.
As soon as he finished speaking, three black shadows jumped out from the thatch, forming a triangle and surrounding Xiao Yan in the middle. The leader was a muscular man with a face full of flesh. A long scar on the left side of his face extended from the corner of his eye to the corner of his mouth, looking ferocious and terrifying. He held a ghost-headed sword in his hand, and the blade glowed with cold light. It was obviously a weapon that drank blood all year round. The other two minions also held short blades and stared at Xiao Yan fiercely, like hungry wolves staring at their prey.
"Boy, if you are sensible, hand over the money you have on you and the treasures in the book box. Grandpas can still keep your whole body!" Scarface said viciously, his tone full of threats.
Xiao Yan's heart sank. He saw that these three people were dressed in black belts with a pale ghost hand embroidered on the belt - this was the notorious "Ghost Hand Gate" symbol in the world! The "Ghost Hand Sect" is ruthless and specializes in robbing homes and houses, and doing things that are harmful to the environment. They especially like to rob literati, because the literati often carry precious books or calligraphy and paintings, and have weak resistance. I didn't expect that I would meet him today.
"I am Xiao Yan, a descendant of the Xiao family. You dare to block the road and rob someone in broad daylight. Aren't you afraid of being investigated by the government?" Xiao Yan suppressed the fear in his heart and tried to use his family and the government to intimidate the other party. He knew that the Xiao Mansion had some reputation in the local area. His father had been an official in the court during his lifetime. Although he had been dead for many years, the manor still had contacts with some officials. Ordinary bandits would not easily provoke people from the Xiao Mansion.
But when Scarface heard the word "Xiao Mansion", he laughed loudly, the laughter was rough and harsh: "Xiao Mansion? It's just a declining official family. Now in this western border, who doesn't know the reputation of my 'Ghost Hand Sect'? That gang of government officials You have been fed by us for a long time, and you still dare to interfere with your grandfather's affairs." He waved the ghost-headed knife in his hand, "Boy, don't talk nonsense to the grandfather, and hand it over quickly, or you won't blame grandpa for not recognizing anyone with the knife!"
Xiao Yan knew that negotiation was impossible, so he had no choice but to deal with it. He slowly opened the folding fan. The four words "Peace and Peace" were inscribed on the fan, but at this moment it became his only self-defense weapon. He took a deep breath and recalled the punches and kicks his father had taught him. He placed his feet shoulder-width apart and assumed a defensive posture.
Seeing that Xiao Yan dared to resist, Scarface's eyes flashed with a stern look, and he shouted: "You don't know how to live or die! Get it!" before he finished speaking., the two minions next to him rushed forward waving short blades. The minions on the left were faster and stabbed Xiao Yan's chest with the short blade, while the minions on the right attacked his lower body, trying to restrict his movements.
Xiao Yan did not dare to neglect, and swerved to the left to avoid the attack of the left gangster. At the same time, he used the folding fan in his hand to hit the right gangster's wrist hard. There was only a crisp sound of "pop", and the minion on his right side was in pain. The short blade almost fell out of his hand. He screamed and took a few steps back. Seeing that the attack missed, the minion on the left struck again with his sword. Xiao Yan used the flexibility of the folding fan to keep blocking. The fan bone collided with the short blade, making a "dinging" sound.
But after all, Xiao Yan was just a scholar, and his boxing and kicking skills were only superficial. He could barely sustain himself against one minion, but he gradually became unable to deal with two minions. After several rounds, cold sweat broke out on his forehead and his breathing became rapid. Scarface watched coldly from the side. Seeing that Xiao Yan was about to lose his support, he raised a cruel smile on his lips and suddenly joined the battle.
The Ghost Head Sword was so powerful and its wind was so fierce that Xiao Yan did not dare to confront it head-on. He could only keep dodging, but he was still swept by the sword wind several times. His clothes were torn and a shallow wound was left on his arm, and blood seeped out instantly. The pain made Xiao Yan's brain clearer. He knew that he would die sooner or later if he continued like this, and he had to find a way to break out.
He quickly glanced around and found a dense forest not far away. If he could rush into the forest and use the cover of the trees, he might have a chance to survive. So, he deliberately used a flaw, pretending to be exhausted, and took a few steps back. Scarface thought Xiao Yan was at the end of his crossbow, and was overjoyed. He swung his knife and slashed at his neck, hoping to defeat the enemy with one move.
At this critical moment, Xiao Yan suddenly exerted force on his feet, jumped back suddenly, and at the same time threw the folding fan in his hand towards Scarface's eyes. Scarface did not expect Xiao Yan to make such a move, so he hurriedly dodged. Although he avoided the folding fan, he also missed the best opportunity to attack. Xiao Yan took the opportunity to turn around and ran towards the woods.
"Want to run away? It's not that easy!" Scarface roared, leading two minions in pursuit. Xiao Yan ran with all his strength, the wind whistling in his ears, and the footsteps and shouts of death behind him were getting closer and closer. He knew he couldn't stop. Once he was caught up, the consequences would be disastrous.
After running into the woods, the trees were intertwined and the road was rugged. Xiao Yan relied on his flexible body to shuttle between the trees. Although Scarface and the others were very skilled, they were unable to perform well in the woods and their speed slowed down. Xiao Yan took the opportunity to distance himself a bit, but after all, his physical strength was limited. After running for a while, his legs felt weak and his breathing became increasingly difficult.
Just when he could no longer hold on, the sound of horse hooves suddenly came from ahead. Xiao Yan was overjoyed, as if he had seen a savior. He used his last bit of strength to shout in the direction of the sound of horse hooves: "Help! Help!"
The sound of horse hooves got closer and closer, and soon, a group of officers and soldiers appeared in Xiao Yan's sight. The leader was a general in armor. When he saw Xiao Yan's embarrassed appearance and the "Ghost Hand Sect" men chasing behind him, his face sank and he shouted: "You bold thief, how dare you plunder in broad daylight, catch me!"
The officers and soldiers were well-trained. After hearing the general's order, they immediately drew the sabers at their waists and rushed towards Scarface and others. When Scarface saw the officers and soldiers coming, he was shocked. He knew that he was no match, so he dared to fight. He hurriedly took his two minions to escape. Otherwise, I might have been killed by the thieves."
When the general heard the word "Xiao Yan", a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes, and then he smiled and said: "It turns out to be Mr. Xiao, whose name I have admired for a long time. I am the local guard Li Wei, and I was patrolling here under the orders of the prefect. I didn't expect to encounter this incident. Mr. Xiao, you don't have to be polite. It is our duty to catch the bandits."
Later, Li Wei asked his officers and soldiers to escort Scarface and others back to the government for interrogation, and sent two more soldiers to escort Xiao Yan back to the Xiao Mansion. After Xiao Yan thanked Li Wei again, he continued on his way back to Xiao Mansion under the escort of soldiers.
At this time, the sunset had already set, night began to fall, and sporadic lights lit up on both sides of the road. Xiao Yan looked at the soldiers escorting him with emotion in his heart. He did not expect that an ordinary return trip would encounter such a thrilling incident. If General Li Wei had not arrived in time, the consequences would have been disastrous. At the same time, he also realized that the world was dangerous and he could not cope with various crises with just his own superficial skills. Perhaps, he should improve his strength, not only to protect himself, but also to protect those around him.
After thinking about it, the gate of Xiao Mansion appeared in front of me. When the servant at the door saw Xiao Yan coming back, he hurriedly greeted him and helped him into the mansion. Xiao Yan knew that this encounter was just an episode in his life, and he might encounter more challenges in the future, but he was ready to face everything that came next.
Xiao Yan, escorted by two soldiers, finally stepped into the gate of Xiao Mansion. The lanterns in the mansion had already been lit, and the warm yellow light dissipated the chill of the night, but it failed to completely relieve the panic in his heart. Seeing his return, the servant hurriedly stepped forward to take the book box that had been released from his hand. His face was full of concern: "Master, you are back. The old lady has been waiting for you at the door every day these days."
Xiao Yan nodded and walked toward the inner courtyard with a slightly frivolous pace. As soon as I reached the door of the main hall, I saw the old lady walking out with the support of the maid, leaning on a cane. The old lady's hair was already graying, and her face was covered with traces of time. When she saw Xiao Yan, tears instantly filled her eyes: "Yan'er, you are back, have you suffered outside?"
Xiao Yan stepped forward quickly, held the old lady's hand, and said in a hoarse voice: "Mom, I made you worry. I'm fine. I just encountered a little twists and turns on the road." He didn't want the old lady to worry too much, so he briefly talked about the robbery.
But the old lady was so shrewd. She saw the bandaged wound on Xiao Yan's arm and the damage marks on his clothes at a glance. Her face suddenly darkened: "Yan'er, tell me honestly, did you encounter danger on the road? What happened to this wound?"
Seeing that he could not hide it from the old lady, Xiao Yan had no choice but to tell the story of how he was robbed by the "Ghost Hand Gate" minions on the road and was fortunately rescued by the officers and soldiers led by General Li Wei. The old lady was frightened when she heard this. She held Xiao Yan's hand tightly, tears sliding down her cheeks: "My son, I really scared my mother to death. Fortunately, you are fine. If you had some shortcomings, how would your mother live?"
Xiao Yan quickly comforted him: "Mom, don't worry, I'm back fine. Thanks to General Li Wei's timely arrival, otherwise I might not have been able to come back. Moreover, those minions from the 'Ghost Hand Sect' have been caught by the officers and soldiers. The government should interrogate them strictly and will not let them come out to harm others again."
The old lady felt relieved a little and took Xiao Yan into the main hall, asking the maid to quickly prepare hot water and food. Xiao Yan sat on the chair, looking at the familiar scene in front of her, the uneasiness in her heart gradually dissipated. he picked upHe put the tea cup on the table and took a sip of hot tea. The warmth spread down his throat and spread throughout his body, and a feeling of exhaustion also came to his heart.
It didn't take long for the food to be served. The old lady kept picking up food for Xiao Yan, telling him to eat more to replenish his strength. While Xiao Yan was eating, he chatted with the old lady about his experience at Yuntaishan Academy and how he found the "Commentaries on the Nam Hua Sutra", trying to completely put the old lady at ease.
After the meal, the old lady was worried that Xiao Yan was tired and asked him to go back to his room to rest quickly. Xiao Yan returned to his room. The furnishings in the room were still the same, and the books he was studying before leaving were still on the desk. He walked to the desk, opened the book box, and looked at the precious "Commentaries on the Nam Hua Sutra" inside, with mixed feelings in his heart. If it weren't for this book, he wouldn't have stayed in the mountains for half a month, let alone encountered this disaster on his way back.
He took off his torn clothes, looked at the wounds on his arms, and recalled the scene of the fight with the "Ghost Hand Sect" minions during the day, still feeling frightened in his heart. He knew that his lucky escape this time was all due to luck and General Li Wei's timely rescue. If he encountered such danger next time, he might not have such good luck.
"It seems that I can no longer just focus on book knowledge. Only by improving my martial arts can I protect myself and my family in this dangerous world." Xiao Yan secretly made up his mind. He remembered that his father had left some martial arts secrets before his death, which were stored in a secret room in the study. Perhaps he could start with these secrets and start learning real martial arts.
Early the next morning, Xiao Yan came to the study. The study room is filled with the faint fragrance of ink, and the bookshelves are filled with various books, including collections of classics and history, as well as some secret books on the art of war and martial arts. He walked to the bookshelf and turned a copy of "The Art of War" on the bookshelf according to the method his father told him before he was alive. The bookshelf slowly moved to one side, revealing a hidden compartment.
There was a wooden box in the secret compartment. Xiao Yan opened the wooden box, and there were indeed several yellowed martial arts secret books inside, namely "Flowing Cloud Sword Technique", "Qingfeng Palm Technique" and "Basic Internal Skills and Heart Techniques". He picked up a book called "Basic Internal Strength and Mental Techniques" and started reading it carefully. The content of the Heart Method was obscure and difficult to understand, and he had never seen many of the terms in it, but he did not give up. Instead, he patiently studied it word for word and sentence by sentence. When he encountered something he did not understand, he marked it and planned to ask someone who knew martial arts for advice in the future.
Just when Xiao Yan was immersed in the world of martial arts secrets, the housekeeper suddenly walked in and said respectfully: "Sir, there is a soldier sent by General Li Wei outside. He said he has something important to ask you."
Xiao Yan's heart moved, he put down the secret book in his hand, and said: "Invite him in quickly."
After a while, a soldier in armor walked into the study and raised his hand to Xiao Yan: "Master Xiao, I am a soldier under General Li Wei. The interrogation has begun, and they confessed that the "Ghost Hand Sect" has been active in the West Frontier area recently, and seems to be looking for a precious treasure, and they also plan to attack the Xiao Mansion because they heard that there is an ancestral treasure hidden in the Xiao Mansion.
